changelog:
Homelab 1.6.4 — 首个正式发布 / First Release

本项目 fork 自开源 Homelab 客户端，在此基础上新增了以下功能：
Forked from an open-source Homelab client with the following additions:

新增功能 / New Features

- **全新首页仪表盘** / New Home Dashboard：系统健康（CPU/内存/磁盘温度）、Docker 容器、qBittorrent 卡片，10 秒自动刷新 — system health, Docker containers, and qBittorrent cards with 10-second auto-refresh
- **CloudSaver 影视模块** / CloudSaver Media Module：海报搜索、一键转存、看完即触发插件/运行、JWT 过期自动重登 — poster search, one-tap transfer, auto-trigger plugins after watching, auto re-login on JWT expiry
- **OpenList 播放器升级为开源 VLCKit** / OpenList player powered by VLCKit：支持 MKV/AVI 等多格式、离线缓存与画中画 — MKV/AVI and more formats, offline cache, Picture-in-Picture
- **Arcane 交互式终端** / Arcane Interactive Terminal（开源 SwiftTerm）：容器镜像/统计、日志查看 — container images/statistics and logs
- **qBittorrent 详情增强** / Enhanced qBittorrent details：Tracker 与限速管理 — Tracker and rate-limit management
- **一键切换局域网/远程模式、批量替换主机地址、外挂字幕** / One-tap LAN vs. remote mode, bulk host replacement, external subtitles
- **Liquid Glass 视觉打磨** / Liquid Glass visual polish（OpenList/Arcane/qB/CloudSaver）

> 注意 / Note：IPA 使用免费 Apple ID 签名（development profile，2026-08-12 到期），到期后请通过 SideStore/AltStore 刷新 — signed with a free Apple ID, refresh via SideStore/AltStore after expiry.
